description: This file contains unit tests for the OCIContainer class, using Google Test framework. It tests various container management functionalities such as listing containers, getting container state and info, starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and executing commands within containers. The tests mock dependencies like DobbyProxy and IpcService to verify the behavior of the OCIContainer handler.
